description: ArduPilot adapter overrides for a px4-ekf-flow (plugin) PID tuning profile. EKF: NavEKF3 is ready ~33 s after start (ArduPilot's GPS checks), PX4's EKF2 ~10 s. Search ranges: with ArduPilot's gyro low-pass (INS_GYRO_FILTER) the rate loop is stable only with a small rate P (ArduPilot's default 0.135), and a static trim must be removed by the rate integrator (ArduPilot's convention I = P), so the hover phase searches the rate I too. Yaw, altitude and horizontal keep the PX4 ranges (the yaw loop needs the PX4 rate P range to meet the 0.5 Hz phase gate). Hard gates: ArduPilot's yaw loop is shaped more slowly by design (ATC_ACCEL_Y_MAX, yaw rate filters): with ArduPilot's default gains the 0.5 Hz yaw phase lag is 77 deg (EAMS, 3 ms), so the angle gate is 90 deg instead of PX4's 50.
